text:
I'm sorry your order shows delivered but hasn't arrived, that's frustrating. Please contact support with your order number (it looks like LF-123456), and we'll open a courier investigation, which can take up to 5 business days. If the package is confirmed lost, you can choose either a free replacement or a full refund.

In the meantime, tracking can take up to 24 hours to update, so it's worth checking again, and also looking around your delivery address, such as with neighbours or in a safe spot near the door.

If you share your order number here, I can help get this moving. Please don't send any card numbers or passwords.
